scope: Metadata-only malignancy eligibility proposal for future formal cohort v2; engineering pilot remains on frozen v1.
timing_disclosure: Review discovered after the development pilot had started, before opening CTRP responses; this is a documented metadata-driven amendment, not a claim of pre-pilot preregistration.

rules.explicit_non_cancerous: Exact OncotreePrimaryDisease == Non-Cancerous. No response or performance filter.
rules.disease_unknown: ModelID absent from current Broad Model metadata, or primary-disease annotation empty; not evidence that model is non-cancerous.
rules.other_annotated: Disease field nonempty and not exactly Non-Cancerous; must preserve source term, not infer additional histology.
rules.candidate_A: Exclude explicit Non-Cancerous from cancer-focused primary analysis; retain unknown annotation with flag pending authoritative review.
rules.candidate_B: Exclude explicit Non-Cancerous and quarantine unknown annotation from cancer-focused primary analysis pending authoritative resolution.
rules.related_models: Count by known biological group; eligibility must not change fold separation or create identity overlap.
rules.non_cancer_controls: Retain source data and explicit identities for separately labelled optional controls/sensitivity, not pooled cancer primary inference.
rules.unknown_resolution: Check authoritative cell-line provenance, e.g. Sanger/Cellosaurus/2018 annotations, using identity metadata only; document evidence before formal cohort v2 freeze.
rules.panel: Preserve frozen drug panel and rank. Do not replace drugs based on coverage after inspecting outcomes or model performance.

next_gate: Choose and document primary malignancy rule, resolve disease-unknown model if possible, create auditable formal cohort v2 overlay and new freeze before formal full analysis; preserve v1 and this pilot.
